crossRefs.note: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

parallels.note: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the…
He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

translations.web: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And he that sitteth on anything whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
